# om_kh Apify Actors

> 76 ready-to-run data Actors on Apify by om_kh: YouTube transcripts, comments and channel search, Google Trends, Google News, company job listings from ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday), reviews, social profiles, Google Maps, e-commerce and ad libraries. Pay per result. Callable from the Apify API, n8n/Make/Zapier, or any MCP client via https://mcp.apify.com.

## Guides

- [How do I get the transcript of a YouTube video with an API?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/youtube-transcript-api-python.html): Get the transcript of any YouTube video as text, timestamped segments, SRT, VTT or RAG chunks from Python, JavaScript or cURL. No YouTube API key.
- [Is there a Google Trends API?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/google-trends-api.html): Unofficial Google Trends API: interest over time, average, peak, % change, top regions, rising and breakout queries, and daily trending searches, as JSON or CSV.
- [How do I find YouTube influencers in a niche with their email?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/find-youtube-channels-with-email.html): Search YouTube channels by keyword, filter by subscriber count and country, and get social links and public business emails for influencer outreach.
- [How do I get all open jobs from a company's Greenhouse, Lever or Workday career page?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/greenhouse-lever-workday-jobs-api.html): Get current job listings from any company's ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Personio, Rippling) as clean JSON, filtered by keyword and location.
- [How do I get Google News results as JSON by API?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/google-news-api.html): Get Google News articles for any keyword as JSON: headline, publisher, date, snippet and link, for any country edition and time range. No API key.
- [How do I export all comments from a YouTube video?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/export-youtube-comments.html): Download the comments of any YouTube video or Short with likes, reply count, author, date and hearted flag. No API key, no quota.
- [How do I export who an Instagram account follows?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/export-instagram-following-list.html): Get the accounts a public Instagram profile follows, with username, full name, followers and public contact, as CSV or JSON.
- [How do I find new businesses that just opened in my city?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/new-businesses-google-maps.html): Get businesses that newly appeared on Google Maps for any category and city — name, address, rating, categories — for local B2B lead generation.
- [How do I find the email address of a YouTube channel?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/youtube-channel-email-finder.html): Get the public business email of YouTube channels from the channel bio or the creator's website, MX-checked, with socials, country and subscribers.
- [How do I get SEEK or JobStreet job listings with an API?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/seek-jobstreet-jobs-api.html): Get job listings from SEEK (AU, NZ), JobStreet (MY, SG, ID, PH) and JobsDB (HK, TH) as JSON with parsed salary, company and full description.
- [How do I get Kalshi and Polymarket odds by API?](https://omarkhandji-commits.github.io/apify-actor-catalogue/guides/kalshi-polymarket-api.html): Live Kalshi and Polymarket odds in one table: implied probability, bid/ask, 24h move, volume and liquidity for any topic.
